reviews.name: Maya Brennan
reviews.review: Smooth, easy purchase from start to finish. They had the A6 detailed and waiting, the paperwork took under an hour, and nobody pushed extended warranties on me.

reviews.name: Daniel Okafor
reviews.review: Bought a '95 Firebird here and the salesman knew more about it than I did. Fair price, honest about the rust on the rear quarter panel. Would buy from them again.

reviews.name: Priya Raman
reviews.review: The MX-5 was exactly as described and the finance team beat my credit union's rate. Great experience overall.

reviews.name: Tom Kowalski
reviews.review: Came in to look at a Spectra. The car was on the lot as listed and the test drive was about fifteen minutes. I decided to keep shopping.

reviews.name: Rosa Delgado
reviews.review: Waited forty minutes for anyone to help us, then the Yukon we called about had already been sold. Nobody bothered to tell us. Wasted afternoon.

reviews.name: Marcus Hill
reviews.review: They added a $900 'protection package' to the price after we'd agreed on a number. I bought the Aveo anyway because I needed it, but I felt cheated.

reviews.name: Hannah Lindqvist
reviews.review: Test drove the 4Runner on a Saturday. The listing price matched the sticker. Their trade-in offer was lower than I expected, so I walked.

reviews.name: Kevin Tran
reviews.review: Excellent service department and a genuinely friendly sales team. The 530 has been perfect for three months now.

reviews.name: Aisha Mohammed
reviews.review: Terrible communication. The Escalade needed a new battery two days after pickup and it took a week of calls to get them to cover it.

reviews.name: Greg Patterson
reviews.review: Looked at a Ram Van for my business. The van had 140,000 miles and the price reflected that. Did not buy.

reviews.name: Lauren Choi
reviews.review: Second car I've bought here. Same great salesperson, same no-nonsense process, and they remembered my trade-in history. Love this place.

reviews.name: Andre Baptiste
reviews.review: The Saab is lovely but the dealership was disorganized. They lost my signed title application and I had to come back twice.

reviews.name: Megan O'Leary
reviews.review: Picked up the Exige and the whole team came out to see it off. Fun, knowledgeable people who clearly care about cars.

reviews.name: Luis Navarro
reviews.review: Paperwork took most of the day. The Spider was the listed price.

reviews.name: Sarah Whitfield
reviews.review: The sales manager was rude when I asked to have the 550 inspected by my own mechanic. That's an instant no from me.

reviews.name: Jamal Carter
reviews.review: Got a fair trade-in value for my old truck and a clean F-150. Quick, transparent, and the finance guy explained every line.

reviews.name: Emily Novak
reviews.review: Drove the Z3 around the block. They wanted a deposit before showing me the service records, which I declined.

reviews.name: Raj Mehta
reviews.review: The Taurus had a check-engine light on the drive home. To their credit they fixed it the next morning at no charge and apologized. Good recovery.

reviews.name: Chloe Fournier
reviews.review: Asked for the out-the-door price on the S-Class three times and never got a straight answer. Horrible, evasive sales tactics.

reviews.name: Brian Sullivan
reviews.review: The M5 was listed online but the salesperson said it was 'in transit.' I called twice more and was told the same thing.

reviews.name: Nina Petrova
reviews.review: Honest, patient staff. They let me take the Lancer to my mechanic and adjusted the price when he found worn brake pads. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Carlos Romero
reviews.review: Loud, high-pressure showroom. I felt rushed the entire time and left without the Endeavor.

reviews.name: Grace Kim
reviews.review: Bought a used Cabriolet. The car came with two keys and a full tank of gas. Delivery was scheduled for the following Tuesday.

reviews.name: Derek Lawson
reviews.review: Very disappointed. They advertised the RX-8 with a new engine rebuild and couldn't produce a single receipt for it.

reviews.name: Fatima Haddad
reviews.review: Browsed the New Beetle and a couple of others. The lot is small and the inventory list on their website is accurate.

reviews.name: Ryan McAllister
reviews.review: Classic Passat in wonderful shape for the price. The owner of the dealership walked me through its full history. Delighted.

reviews.name: Olivia Grant
reviews.review: The Sport Trac drives well, but the registration paperwork arrived six weeks late and I got a ticket for expired temporary tags. Frustrating.

reviews.name: Sam Nguyen
reviews.review: Buying a 911 can be intimidating, but they made it easy and fun. Clear pricing, a thorough inspection report, and real enthusiasm.

reviews.name: Teresa Morales
reviews.review: Solid minivan, decent price, no surprises. The kids love the Odyssey and so do I.

reviews.name: Josh Feldman
reviews.review: Damaged trim on the CL-Class that wasn't disclosed, and they refused to fix it after the sale. Avoid.

reviews.name: Keisha Brooks
reviews.review: Picked up the GTO on a Friday. Financing went through our bank.

reviews.name: Paul Lindgren
reviews.review: Friendly salespeople and a spotless Sedona. They even installed the car seats for us before we drove off. Wonderful family experience.

reviews.name: Ana Costa
reviews.review: The GTO was clean but they charged a dealer prep fee that was never mentioned. Annoying, though the car itself is great.

reviews.name: Victor Ibrahim
reviews.review: Quick, easy, and pleasant. The Mazda6 was ready when they said it would be and the price matched the online quote exactly.

reviews.name: Rachel Stein
reviews.review: Viewed the TrailBlazer twice. The second visit they had moved it to another location, which added about an hour of driving.

reviews.name: Ethan Walker
reviews.review: Worst dealership experience of my life. The Suburban broke down on the highway the week I bought it and they claimed it was my fault.

reviews.name: Mei Lin
reviews.review: The IS F is fantastic and the service advisor is helpful and responsive. Easy recommendation.

reviews.name: Omar Siddiqui
reviews.review: The L-Series was fine. Sales staff were neither pushy nor especially helpful.

reviews.name: Jenna Hartley
reviews.review: Salesperson was condescending and kept talking to my husband instead of me, even though I was the buyer. Rude and insulting. We left.

reviews.name: Diego Alvarez
reviews.review: Asked about the B-Series pickup. They said it was available and quoted a price over the phone. I bought elsewhere.

reviews.name: Lisa Moreau
reviews.review: Bought an old Rodeo for camping trips. They threw in new tires and were upfront about everything. Great small dealer.

reviews.name: Tyler Benson
reviews.review: Bought the Voyager as a work van. Pickup was at 9 a.m. and the title arrived by mail.

reviews.name: Yuki Tanaka
reviews.review: The Altima I came to see had obvious hail damage that wasn't in the photos. Misleading listing.

reviews.name: Brandon Ellis
reviews.review: Looked at the i-350. The price was standard for the area.

reviews.name: Sofia Rossi
reviews.review: They hounded me with calls and texts for weeks after a single test drive. Pushy and exhausting.

reviews.name: Kwame Mensah
reviews.review: Professional, courteous, and efficient. The 760 was immaculate and they handled the out-of-state registration for me.

reviews.name: Heather Doyle
reviews.review: A Maybach is a big purchase and they treated it that way: private viewing, detailed history, excellent follow-up. Superb.

reviews.name: Nathan Price
reviews.review: The S-Series broke down twice in the first month. Their so-called inspection obviously never happened, and the dealer refused to pay for repairs.

reviews.name: Leila Farahani
reviews.review: Great price on the CL-Class and a friendly, knowledgeable salesman. Happy with my purchase.

reviews.name: Chris Dunbar
reviews.review: Test drove the DeVille. The interior reeked of smoke, which they never mentioned. Disappointing.
